lines.speaker: fei
lines.en: See? I can do this. The Crossroads will be easy.

lines.speaker: xiaolong
lines.en: (He sniffs. Fei already smells like fog.)

lines.speaker: fei
lines.en: Don't be {C121} for glory — leave some for me!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: He runs ahead, toward the Crossroads, before you can stop him.
